status: Post hoc diagnostic specified during the primary campaign; not a prespecified primary endpoint; do not execute until primary and serial timing campaigns complete
selection_scope: Four fixed stage-zero decisions, two target/initial-condition blocks in each mathematical family; no representative sampling or universal optimizer claim
information: Only observed state, declared model family, target, saved fixed reference/basis, saved controller scenario list, and the first recorded theta; actual hidden process parameters and future observations are not optimizer inputs
comparison: Saved 12-iteration scenario-feedback incumbent versus three offline direct optimizations with maxiter=60 and the exact frozen objective, constraints, numerics, merit and candidate selection

offline_arms.start: saved first trace theta, whose gain must be zero

saved_incumbent_policy: The saved 12-iteration candidate is reported and independently re-evaluated as a comparator; it is not silently supplied as an incumbent to the three offline optimizers
retained_evidence: All initial candidate evaluations, all optimizer evaluations, candidate exceptions, solver termination, selected theta/gain, finite-model feasibility, violation, penalized merit, mean log biomass, arithmetic mean biomass, model-call counts and separate offline elapsed cost
timing: Sequential offline execution only after both campaign completion records exist; replay/preparation and every optimization arm recorded separately. Entire diagnostic excluded from main online controller times. No timing superiority inference from comparison with parallel primary timings
interpretation: A larger local optimization budget and an alternative feasible-family start can diagnose search sensitivity. A feasible witness is not a global optimum, failure is not an infeasibility proof, and no selected action is executed in or fed back to the primary campaign
